_schema.purpose: Post-filing divergencias defense corpus. Each case is a fictional AT 'Divergencia na declaracao Mod. 3' scenario with the correct response path, the cited deadline basis, the documents that actually rebut the flag, the trap a naive response falls into, and a severity. Used by scripts/validate.py --selftest for schema + integrity gating. Figures/rules dated to income year 2025 (filed 2026); re-verify against info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt before a live filing.

key_deadlines.notification_response_window: 15 days from the divergencia notification date to justify or substitute; extendable to 25 days where documented difficulty in obtaining evidence exists (AT divergencia notification practice — Doutor Financas / CGD Saldo Positivo, 2026).
key_deadlines.substituicao_no_coima_window: A corrected substitute declaration filed inside the normal Modelo 3 filing window (1 April - 30 June) carries NO coima; after that date it may imply a coima depending on the correction's effect (AT folheto 'Divergencias na declaracao Mod. 3', maio 2026, PENALIDADES).
key_deadlines.reclamacao_graciosa: 120 days to lodge a reclamacao graciosa against a liquidacao act (CPPT art. 70.o, counted from the CPPT art. 102.o events).
key_deadlines.juros_compensatorios_rate: 4%/year legal interest (Portaria 291/2003; LGT art. 35.o n.o 10 referencing Codigo Civil art. 559.o), accrued day-by-day: imposto x 0.04 x dias / 365 (LGT art. 35.o).
key_deadlines.rgit_art30_reduction: Coima reduced to 12.5% of the legal minimum if payment is requested before any auto de noticia / participacao / inspection begins; to 50% of the legal minimum up to the audicao previa deadline within a tax inspection — conditioned on paying within 30 days of the reduced-coima notification and regularising (RGIT art. 30.o, Lei 7/2021 in force from 2022).
key_deadlines.rgit_art29_dispensa: No coima where, cumulatively, the agent had no conviction/benefit in the prior 5 years, the infraction caused no prejuizo efetivo to tax revenue, and the fault is regularised (RGIT art. 29.o).
key_deadlines.rgit_art31_minimum: Where the coima varies with the tax due, the minimum is 10% (individuals) or 20% (companies) of the tax owed (RGIT art. 31.o).

cases.title: Portal alert that the declaration was liquidated with no divergencia
cases.situation: After submitting inside the window, the household sees a Portal das Financas status message that the declaration was received and liquidada 'certa' (no divergencia flag raised), plus the routine pre-filing e-Fatura 'faturas pendentes de validacao' reminder from earlier in the cycle still sitting in their inbox.
cases.deadline_basis: None — this is not a divergencia notification. A liquidacao 'certa'/'sem divergencias' status and the pre-filing e-Fatura validation reminder are informational only; no response window runs (AT folheto 'Divergencias na declaracao Mod. 3', maio 2026 — only a 'Divergencia' designation opens a response duty).
cases.trap: Treating a routine liquidacao-status message or a stale pre-filing e-Fatura reminder as a divergencia and filing an unnecessary substitute declaration — which after 30 June can itself trigger a coima. Read the exact alert designation before acting.

cases.title: Health deduction declared exceeds e-Fatura Saude total
cases.situation: The household manually entered a higher saude deduction in Anexo H than the total the AT holds in the e-Fatura 'Saude' category; the AT raises a divergencia asking them to justify the excess.
cases.deadline_basis: 15 days from the divergencia notification to justify or substitute (extendable to 25 with documented difficulty) — Doutor Financas / CGD Saldo Positivo, 2026.
documents_needed: itemized recibos/faturas de saude that support the declared amount (VAT-exempt or 6% health invoices)
prescription proof for any 23%-VAT health expense claimed as deductible
e-Fatura Saude category export showing which invoices are already counted
cases.trap: Assuming the higher self-entered figure is automatically accepted. Only e-Fatura-registered saude plus manually-justifiable health expenses count; a declared excess with no invoice behind it must be justified with documents or the declaration substituted down — not defended by assertion.

cases.title: Foreign dividends omitted — Anexo J missing
cases.situation: A resident received dividends from a foreign brokerage; the AT cross-matched CRS/bank data and raised a divergencia because no Anexo J was filed. The household thought the small foreign amount did not need declaring.
cases.deadline_basis: Substitute declaration adding Anexo J; if filed inside 1 April - 30 June no coima applies, after that a coima may apply depending on effect (AT folheto maio 2026). Anexo J is mandatory for foreign-source income regardless of amount.
documents_needed: foreign brokerage annual tax statement (dividends gross, foreign withholding tax)
proof of foreign tax paid for the credito de imposto por dupla tributacao internacional
cases.trap: Believing a low foreign amount is exempt from declaration. Foreign-source income requires Anexo J regardless of size; the fix is a full substitute declaration including every previously-correct annex, not a text justification that the amount was trivial.

cases.title: Rent deduction claimed without recibo eletronico de renda
cases.situation: A tenant claimed a housing-rent deduction, but the AT has no matching recibo eletronico de renda from the landlord on file, so a divergencia is raised on the arrendamento deduction.
cases.deadline_basis: 15 days from notification to justify with supporting evidence (extendable to 25) — Doutor Financas / CGD Saldo Positivo, 2026.
documents_needed: contrato de arrendamento registered with the AT
recibos de renda eletronicos, or proof of rent paid (bank transfers) plus the landlord's declaration
proof the property is the permanent residence (domicilio fiscal)
cases.trap: Claiming the rent deduction when the landlord never issued recibos eletronicos de renda — the deduction is AT-cross-referenced against the landlord's Categoria F declaration. Justify with a registered contract and payment proof, or the deduction is disallowed; do not just re-assert the figure.

cases.title: Property sale — valorization expenses challenged (mais-valias imobiliarias)
cases.situation: The household sold a property and declared valorization works and acquisition/sale costs in the 'Despesas e encargos' column of Anexo G; the AT raises a divergencia asking them to prove those expenses.
cases.deadline_basis: 15 days from notification to justify with comprovativos (extendable to 25) — Doutor Financas / CGD Saldo Positivo, 2026. Deductible expenses are limited to valorization works comprovadamente realizados in the last 12 years plus necessary acquisition/sale costs (CIRS art. 51.o).
documents_needed: escritura/IMT and Imposto do Selo on acquisition and sale
notary and predial registration charges
invoices for valorization works within the last 12 years (CIRS art. 51.o)
energy certification and real-estate mediation commission invoices
cases.trap: Declaring valorization expenses without invoices, or works older than the 12-year window of CIRS art. 51.o. Only comprovadamente-realizados costs inside the statutory window reduce the mais-valia; undocumented or out-of-window expenses are struck out.

cases.title: Sold shares at a loss, forgot Anexo G
cases.situation: The household sold listed securities during the year at a net loss and did not file Anexo G, assuming a loss needs no declaration. The AT raises a divergencia on the omitted alienacao onerosa de valores mobiliarios.
cases.deadline_basis: Substitute declaration adding Anexo G; Anexo G (and Anexo J for foreign-held securities) is mandatory whether the apurado result is positive OR negative (AT folheto maio 2026). No coima if inside 1 April - 30 June.
documents_needed: broker statement with acquisition and disposal dates and values
record of any incurred expenses on the transactions
cases.trap: Assuming a capital loss need not be declared. Declaring the loss is mandatory and also preserves the right to carry it forward against future gains; skipping Anexo G forfeits that and triggers the divergencia.

cases.title: Categoria B income inconsistent with CAE / cadastro
cases.situation: A freelancer declared Categoria B professional income in Anexo B under a field that does not match the activity code (CAE) they are registered for in the AT cadastro; the AT raises a 'coerencia de CAE, cadastro e rendimentos declarados' divergencia.
cases.deadline_basis: 15 days from notification to justify or substitute (extendable to 25) — Doutor Financas / CGD Saldo Positivo, 2026. The income type declared in Anexo B must be compatible with the declared/cadastro activity codes (AT folheto maio 2026).
documents_needed: recibos verdes / faturas showing the true nature of the income
current cadastro extract with the registered CAE / activity codes
cases.trap: Declaring service income under the wrong Anexo B field relative to the registered CAE. If the cadastro is wrong, the activity registration must be corrected too — a one-off justification that ignores a genuinely mis-registered activity leaves the same divergencia recurring next year.

cases.title: Withholding-tax figure differs from employer DMR data
cases.situation: The retencao na fonte the household typed into Anexo A does not match the withholding the employer reported to the AT via the DMR; a divergencia is raised on the retencao value.
cases.deadline_basis: 15 days from notification to justify or substitute (extendable to 25) — Doutor Financas / CGD Saldo Positivo, 2026.
documents_needed: recibos de vencimento for the year showing gross income and withholding per month
the employer's declaracao anual de rendimentos / DMR summary if available
cases.trap: Defending the self-typed withholding number against the employer's reported figure. The AT holds the employer's DMR as the reference; if the payslips confirm the employer figure, substitute to match it — a mismatch that favours the taxpayer without payslip proof will be corrected against them.

cases.title: Divergencia entangled with mid-year residency change and IFICI
cases.situation: A newly-arrived resident with a part-year residency period, an IFICI (ex-NHR) election in progress, and foreign employment income receives a divergencia mixing residency-period income splitting with the Anexo L regime. The household asks the skill to draft the justification.
cases.deadline_basis: The 15-day response window still runs (Doutor Financas / CGD, 2026) — but request the extension to 25 days for documented difficulty and hand the substance to an OCC. Residency-period splitting and IFICI eligibility are specialist determinations, not self-service justifications.
documents_needed: certificate of tax residency / arrival date evidence
IFICI eligibility documentation and Anexo L registration status
foreign employer income and foreign tax statements
cases.trap: Self-drafting a justification that asserts a residency split or IFICI treatment. This skill flags and routes to an OCC; getting the residency period or the Anexo L qualifying-activity classification wrong in a justification can lock in an incorrect liquidacao. Escalate immediately, do not resolve.

cases.title: Divergencia ignored — correcao oficiosa and juros compensatorios
cases.situation: The household ignored a divergencia notification past the 15-day window. The AT issued a correcao oficiosa / liquidacao adicional with more tax due plus juros compensatorios, and the household now wants to contest it.
cases.deadline_basis: 120 days to lodge a reclamacao graciosa against the liquidacao (CPPT art. 70.o). Juros compensatorios accrue at 4%/year day-by-day: imposto x 0.04 x dias / 365 (LGT art. 35.o; Portaria 291/2003 / Codigo Civil art. 559.o).
documents_needed: the liquidacao adicional / correcao oficiosa notice with the juros compensatorios breakdown
the supporting documents that would have rebutted the original divergencia
computation of the juros using imposto x 0.04 x dias / 365 to check the AT figure
cases.trap: Believing an ignored divergencia simply disappears. It converts into a correcao oficiosa with additional tax AND juros compensatorios at 4%/year; the only remaining route is a reclamacao graciosa within 120 days (CPPT art. 70.o), a slower and heavier path than answering the original 15-day notice.

cases.title: Genuine omission found after 30 June — coima reduction path
cases.situation: In August the household discovers a genuinely omitted income item (a second-job Categoria A slip) after the 1 April - 30 June window has closed. They want to regularise with the lowest possible penalty before the AT opens any procedure.
cases.deadline_basis: A substitute after 30 June may carry a coima (AT folheto maio 2026). Voluntary early regularisation qualifies for RGIT art. 30.o reduction to 12.5% of the legal minimum when requested before any auto de noticia / participacao / inspection, paid within 30 days of the reduced-coima notification and regularised. Where the coima varies with tax due, the minimum is 10% of the tax for individuals (RGIT art. 31.o); art. 29.o dispensa may even apply if no prejuizo efetivo and a clean 5-year record.
documents_needed: the omitted income document (second-job recibo / slip)
a full substitute declaration including all previously-correct annexes
the pedido de pagamento de coima reduzida, if a coima is assessed
cases.trap: Either doing nothing (letting the AT find it, which forfeits the art. 30.o reduction and risks the full coima plus juros) or overpaying by not requesting the 12.5% reduction. Voluntary pre-procedure regularisation is the cheapest lawful path — but it must be an early request, not a defence after an inspection starts.

cases.title: e-Fatura invoice miscategorized and already excluded by the AT
cases.situation: A private-school payment was sitting under 'Outros' instead of 'Educacao' in e-Fatura, so the AT's pre-filled deduction excluded it; the divergencia (or the smaller-than-expected deduction) stems from the category, not a missing invoice.
cases.deadline_basis: 15 days from notification to justify or substitute (extendable to 25) — Doutor Financas / CGD Saldo Positivo, 2026. The underlying fix is the manual e-Fatura recategorization the taxpayer performs themselves (select invoice -> 'Alterar' -> correct category).
documents_needed: the school/education invoice and its e-Fatura entry showing the wrong category
screenshot of the corrected category after the 'Alterar' step
cases.trap: Confusing a miscategorized-but-present invoice with a missing one. The invoice exists; the deduction was lost to the category, not to absence. Recategorize in e-Fatura and justify/substitute — a 'the receipt is missing' response misdiagnoses the flag and leaves the deduction lost.
